hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Lizu is an Ersuic language not intelligible to Ersu [ers] (or Duoxu) and should be a language separate from the Ersu [ers] entry (**hh:hvw:Yu:Ersuic**:2, **hh:vw:Chirkova:Duoxu**:107). See also: Ersu [ers].

endangerment.comment: Lizu (10624) = Endangered (100 percent certain, based on the evidence available) (fully proficient speakers are all in their 60s or older; in rural areas children still learn the language at home) [Chirkova 2015](cldf:chirkova:15:5)
